dol.records: the record half of the content-metadata bifurcation (core)

A Python mirror of zodal's DataProvider contract (@zodal/store), stdlib
only: the DataProvider protocol (get_list / get_one / create / update /
update_many / delete / delete_many, optional upsert and capabilities),
ListParams (sort, zodal FilterExpression filter, search, pagination;
from_dict reads zodal's JSON shape), ListResult, Capabilities, the
client-side fallbacks filter_to_function (every zodal operator; an
unknown one fails loud) and apply_query, and MappingProvider, the
reference provider over any MutableMapping of id -> record.

Part of #80 (bifurcated_provider and wrap_provider follow).
